notes.summary: 20 posts in the last 7 days (19 replies + 1 quote). Today: 10 replies, 8 of them to queue posts. Together they got 83 views and 1 like, and they went out about a day after the parent posts. Your best reply this week (the ant dentist joke: 5.8k views, 81 likes) was one line on a post with 6.3M views.
lessons: Speed beats everything. Today's replies went out ~23-25h after the posts (Mike's had already hit 275k views) and got 2-17 views each. Reply within 1-2 hours: open the queue soon after it lands and skip any post older than ~6h.

Lead with a sharp line, not agreement. Openers like 'No need to operate like this...', 'Good plan if...' and 'Different types of people...' got 0 likes. Your winners are one witty line (ant dentist, 'vibe add a zero', 'evens perform better'). Open with the punchline, a number, or a contrarian take.

Use the specifics. None of the 8 queue drafts went out as written (0 of 8 were 60%+ similar), so the concrete hooks ('rings out after 5pm', 'the next number on Google') got lost. Keep your voice, but add one specific trades detail or number to each reply.
trends: Target size matters most: the 6.3M-view post produced 5.8k views. Mid-size posts (6k-200k views) gave 46-96 views. Posts that were a day old gave under 20, whatever their size.
Humor vs ops: the 5 jokes and one-liners from 10/17-10/20 averaged about 1,220 views (about 72 without the ant dentist). Today's 10 ops and agreement replies averaged about 8.
Length: winners were under 12 words. Today's replies were 15-40 words.

Accounts: @agazdecki and @cleanwithmike got the most views today (12 and 17 views; 1 like on @agazdecki). @WilsonCompanies and @andywalkerhq got 2 views each, so only reply to them when you're early. Low-effort replies ('Story', '@bot send this...') add nothing; skip them.
